name: Arianna Toniolo
quote: I believe that every place leaves something of itself in those who pass through it.
intro: I created this portfolio as an interactive globe because travel has always been one of my greatest sources of inspiration.
bio1: Every point on the map represents a place that has left a mark on my life: trips with friends, family moments, new experiences and different perspectives that have also influenced the way I create and think.
bio2: I am a Full Stack Developer with 4 years of experience building scalable web applications.
techStack: PHP · TypeScript · Vue 3 · Node.js · PostgreSQL · AWS
